newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -Alex. Brown on Boston Comm.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Alex. Brown on Boston Comm.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown analyst Cato Carpenter said he raised the rating on Boston Communications Group Inc to strong buy from buy in part due to "increased confidence that company will meet or beat seocnd quarter estimates."
-- Carpenter estimated earnings of $0.01 per share for the second quarter, also the First Call consensus estimate. Company lost $0.01 a year ago.
-- said in a research note that he expects its Roamer Plus revenues to be up $1 million in the quarter from the previous period, and will expand more in the third quarter.
-- said its C2C prepaid wireless service "is adding subscribers each month at an accelerating pace..."
